test.name: complete — no missing confounders
missing confounder — candidate correlates with both treatment and outcome
underpowered — tiny strata
adequate — all strata have sufficient n
temporal confound — gradient reverses within periods
true cohort effect — gradient consistent within periods
survivorship confirmed — retired units had worse outcomes
survivorship unlikely — no difference between groups
collider warning — conditioning on B increases correlation
safe — conditioning on B does not increase treatment-confounder correlation
no fallacy — within-group matches between-group
ecological fallacy — within-group differs from between-group
conditional signal exists — subpopulation shows gradient
confirmed null — no signal in expected subpopulation
strong effect modification — treatment effect varies >2x across modifier strata
no modification — treatment effect constant across strata
consistent direction — treatment effect holds across strata
Simpson's Paradox — direction reverses in strata
no absorption — Y retains signal within categories
complete absorption — Y has no signal within any category of X
no mediation — B is unrelated to A
partial mediation — B explains some of A's effect
full mediation — B completely screens A from outcome
T4 structural break fires when stub PELT returns break indices
unknown bucketGrain returns structured error

happy path: comparable sides, no checks fire

K1 frame mismatch blocks when roots differ and justifyMismatch=false
justifyMismatch=true bypasses the K1 block when grains differ
K4 magnitude mismatch fires when sides differ by more than 1 order of magnitude
K6 survivorship fires when either side's flag is true
